name: Officer Saotome
source:
An officer, assigned to the second division of the Special Riot Police. [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]Ayato[/url]'s subordinate. She is a member of the Support Squad, along with her colleague [url=https://vndb.org/c108517]Shiraishi[/url], whose primary mission is to provide cover for the [url=https://vndb.org/c99112]Ayato[/url] and heroines.

It hasn't been long since Saotome joined the Special Riot Police, and she still lacks experience compared to other officers, but she works hard since she is an earnest and upright person. Therefore, her colleagues regard her as someone who will become a veteran before long.

Together with [url=https://vndb.org/c108517]Shiraishi[/url], she is tasked with defending the peace and safety of ordinary citizens and struggling to fulfill the order every day. [url=https://vndb.org/c108517]Shiraishi[/url] regards her as a junior and teases her frequently, yet he also helps her greatly.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.propeller-game.com/product/yuzuriha/chara19.html]official site[/url]]
